baggage_policy._important_correction: The 40 lb limit cited in D2M internal notes is WRONG. Allegiant's actual checked bag limit is 50 lb — same as legacy carriers. The overweight trigger starts at 51 lb, not 41 lb.

base_checked_bag_fees.note: Airport counter rate is flat $75/bag/segment — always book bags in advance

carry_on_fee_usd.note: Carry-on bag IS CHARGED — not free. Allegiant charges for overhead bin use.

baggage_policy.fee_structure_note: ALL fees are per-segment (per takeoff+landing). A round trip = 2 segments = 2× the fee. Connecting itineraries double fees — but Allegiant does not sell connecting itineraries. Round trips are two independent one-way tickets.
baggage_policy.cruise_bag_caveat: Allegiant's 50 lb limit matches legacy carriers, but OVERWEIGHT FEES ARE STEEP. A 51–70 lb bag = $50 extra per segment on top of the base bag fee ($20–$75). For cruise travel with 60–70 lb checked bags, a round trip adds $100 extra ($50 × 2 segments) over the base bag cost. At airport counter rates ($75/bag/segment), a 65 lb bag costs $125/bag/segment = $250 round trip per bag. Pre-book bags to avoid airport pricing.

screening_logic.description: Rules for the flight-price skill Allegiant check
steps: 1. Is the route CONUS-only (both origin and dest are US domestic)? If NO → skip Allegiant check entirely.
2. Is the origin airport in this file's gateways? If YES → check routes array for the destination.
3. If dest found → note Allegiant as an option with sample fare. Add bag-weight caveat.
4. If dest NOT found in routes array → respond: 'Allegiant route not in verified D2M list (verified 2026-06-11). Confirm at allegiantair.com/route-map before ruling out.'
5. If origin NOT in gateways → respond: 'Allegiant coverage for [ORIGIN] not in D2M reference. Check allegiantair.com/route-map.'
6. Always append bag-weight advisory when Allegiant is in the mix.
screening_logic.absence_means: NOT confirmed no-service. Data is point-in-time and covers D2M gateways only. Allegiant adds/drops routes frequently. Always verify at allegiantair.com.
screening_logic.bag_weight_advisory: FLAG when any bag may exceed 50 lb (cruise luggage often 55–70 lb). Allegiant overweight surcharge: $50/segment for 51–70 lb, $75/segment for 71–100 lb — adds $100–$150/bag round trip above base fee. For cruise clients with heavy bags, estimate total Allegiant bag cost vs. included-bag legacy carriers.
